caption: A photorealistic film still from a contemporary Chinese university romance short drama, cinematic live-action realism, square 1:1 image with 1024x1024 framing. Rich but natural skin texture, believable hands, fabrics and practical light, emotionally restrained acting, carefully staged subjects, no text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Gu Xi is a 20-year-old Chinese female art student with long straight black hair, naturally expressive eyes, cream cardigan over white shirt and light blue jeans. Jiang Jin is a 22-year-old Chinese male computer science student with short neat black hair, charcoal jacket over white T-shirt, reserved face and a subtle old scar near his left wrist. Zhou Qian is a Chinese female student aged 21 with long wavy dark hair and powder blue outfit. H University digital art festival takes place in a real modern campus exhibition laboratory with a giant blue-violet LED display and realistic equipment. Triumphant restoration of the digital art exhibit, a massive LED wall now displays a delicate silhouette of a game avatar assembled from thousands of luminous blue and violet fragments on a circular respawn point. In the front foreground Gu Xi and Jiang Jin stand side by side seen from behind, looking up at her successful artwork; two blurred event staff applaud near the edges. Real exhibit hall floor and screen borders clearly visible, majestic cinematic wide framing, restrained uplifting mood.
